source_snapshot.title: Historical photograph of Dubai
source_snapshot.text:
Selected photograph: File:Persian Gulf (4462609004).jpg
Capture date recorded on Commons: 1993-11-01 00:00
Author: Mitch Barrie
Original author description: View of the beach at Dubai where I did some body surfing during the midday break from the GiTex tech fair. Unfortunately, I don't know where this is. It's outside the home of the German women we had working with us in the Systronics stand at the show. I'm guessing it's in Jumeira somewhere.
License: CC BY-SA 2.0
License URL: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0
Image handling: the original JPEG was reviewed visually and matched the Commons SHA-1; no edits were made.
Provenance: Commons transferred this Flickr photo by simonov (Mitch Barrie); FlickreviewR 2 confirmed CC BY-SA 2.0 on 21 February 2018. The original Flickr page opened during this review and confirms November 1993, Dubai beach and uncertainty about Jumeira. Commons records 1 November 1993; exact day is not independently confirmed by the displayed Flickr page.

claims.claim: The photo shows a beach in Dubai in 1993.
The photo was taken by Mitch Barrie during a trip to the GITEX exhibition.
The exact location of the photo is unknown; the author only suggests it might be somewhere in Jumeira.
The photo is titled 'Persian Gulf' and is sourced from Wikimedia Commons under CC BY-SA 2.0 license.
